NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING AND FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, SUCH WAIVER AND COVENANT BY A PARTNER AND THE PARTNERSHIP SHALL NOT APPLY TO ANY ISSUE, CLAIM OR PROCEEDING ARISING UNDER THE FEDERAL SECURITIES LAWS, INCLUDING THE RULES AND REGULATIONS PROMULGATED THEREUNDER, UNLESS OTHERWISE AGREED BY SUCH PARTNER AND THE PARTNERSHIP IN WRITING. THE PARTNERSHIP OR ANY PARTNER MAY FILE AN ORIGINAL COUNTERPART OR A COPY OF THIS SECTION 11.8(B) WITH ANY COURT IN ANY JURISDICTION AS WRITTEN EVIDENCE OF THE CONSENT OF THE </font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="margin-bottom:10pt;text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:133%">6</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="margin-bottom:10pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:133%">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:10pt;padding-left:135pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">PARTNERS TO THE WAIVER OF THEIR RESPECTIVE RIGHTS TO TRIAL BY JURY.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">4.</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:27pt;text-decoration:underline">ENTIRE AGREEMENT</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">.
